QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: The Memory Keeper explained that you must return to your beginnings to regain your lost memory. Beginnings? That would have to be when you met Ryden in the Secret Garden.
QuestInfo.1: You met up with #pRyden# after all this time. You had a warm reunion and Ryden told you how proud he was.
